tasks.title: Lock down the dev task board
tasks.description: /dev-resources/tasks is open to anyone, and its POST routes let any visitor create, edit or delete tasks. Don't mount it in production, or make it admin-only.

tasks.title: Privacy policy and terms
tasks.description: No privacy policy or terms (GDPR, Québec Law 25; mentions légales if selling in France). The app stores emails and project text and sends that text to OpenRouter's model providers. Link them in the footer and on signup.

tasks.title: Acronym runs outlast host timeouts
tasks.description: A measured acronym run took 130 s (single name calls up to 98 s). Many hosts cut requests at 30–100 s. Pick a host without that limit, or run generation as a job the page polls.

tasks.title: Commit the accounts and usage work
tasks.description: About 25 changed and 30 new files (accounts, usage limits, email, cost reports) were never committed; the last commit is df07e51. Commit and push before deploying.

tasks.title: Fix the body-parser vulnerability
tasks.description: npm audit: 1 high-severity issue in body-parser 2.0.0–2.3.0 (denial of service via trailing bytes after a compressed body). npm audit fix resolves it.

tasks.title: Production hosting and env setup
tasks.description: No Dockerfile or Procfile yet. Pick a host and a hosted MongoDB; set NODE_ENV=production, SESSION_SECRET, TRUST_PROXY, APP_URL=https://genlpt.com and a Resend key on a verified domain.

tasks.title: Security headers, logging, monitoring
tasks.description: No security headers (CSP, HSTS, nosniff…), X-Powered-By still sent, no request logs or error monitoring. Add them so production problems are visible.

tasks.title: Public health check calls OpenRouter
tasks.description: GET /api/health pings OpenRouter's /key on every hit with no login needed; POST /api/llm/warmup is open too. Cache the result, or limit them to admins.

tasks.title: Fix APP_URL port in local .env
tasks.description: .env has PORT=3002 but APP_URL=http://localhost:3001, so dev email links (verify, reset) point to the wrong port.

tasks.title: Flesh out the landing page
tasks.description: The landing page is one heading and one sentence. Explain what GenLPT does, show an example acronym, and link to the app and signup.

tasks.title: Don't reveal which emails have accounts
tasks.description: After email provider: all signups get the same full, professional confirmation (taken email: mail owner); same login timing and reset reply.

tasks.title: Decide: paid plan allowance vs unlimited
tasks.description: Decide: does the paid plan get a monthly allowance (recommended, LLM costs vary) or unlimited use with only an hourly anti-burst cap?

tasks.title: Decide: is model choice a paid perk?
tasks.description: Decide: is model choice a paid perk, or one model for everyone? Decides if plain tokens are a fair limit or limits must use cost.

tasks.title: Decide: guest acronym cap strategy
tasks.description: Decide guest acronym cap: generate the full set and lock most (costs more, converts better) or just generate fewer for guests?

tasks.title: Decide: payment provider
tasks.description: Decide payment provider: Stripe, or a merchant of record (Paddle, Lemon Squeezy) that handles VAT/sales tax. Depends where you sell.

tasks.title: Usage log for every LLM call
tasks.description: Usage log: chat() returns token usage + cost; chatJSON records every call (JSON retries, AI titles too) in a UsageEvent collection.

tasks.title: Measure real token cost per action
tasks.description: Measure real token cost per action (words, expand, generate, real-words mode) from the usage log, then set each plan's numbers.

tasks.title: User model
tasks.description: User model: email, passwordHash, emailVerifiedAt, role (user|admin) kept separate from plan (free|paid), subscription subdoc.

tasks.title: Auth: sessions, passwords, login pages
tasks.description: Auth: express-session + connect-mongo, argon2/bcrypt passwords; wire login/signup/logout pages and set req.user (owner.js reads it).

tasks.title: Plans table + entitlements(req)
tasks.description: config/plans.js + entitlements(req): every guest/free/paid limit in one table; code asks entitlements, never checks the plan directly.

tasks.title: Quotas keyed on the owner key
tasks.description: Quotas keyed on the owner key: atomic $inc counters per hour (+ day/month), TTL cleanup. Check before an LLM action, charge real usage after.

tasks.title: One LLM action in flight per owner
tasks.description: One LLM action in flight per owner: a second Generate (e.g. from another tab) gets a 429 until the first one finishes.

tasks.title: Usage meter in the UI
tasks.description: Usage meter in the UI: % of allowance used + reset time. At 0: wait or sign up (guests), wait or upgrade (free).

tasks.title: Server-side plan gating
tasks.description: Server-side plan gating: model choice (POST /sessions and /llm/warmup take any listed model) and Real words only (~40 LLM calls).

tasks.title: Guest acronym cap
tasks.description: Guest acronym cap: send only the top N; the rest stay in DB, withheld from GET /sessions/:id too, and unlock when the guest signs up.

tasks.title: Session caps per plan
tasks.description: Session caps per plan. On paid → free downgrade, sessions over the cap become read-only, never deleted.

tasks.title: Platform daily spend cap
tasks.description: Platform daily spend cap: past it, pause guests first, then free accounts. Also set a credit limit on the OpenRouter key itself.

tasks.title: Email provider for verification + reset
tasks.description: Email via Resend (genlpt.com verified, key in .env) for verification + password reset. Free allowance starts only once the email is verified.

tasks.title: Signup abuse protection
tasks.description: Signup abuse: Cloudflare Turnstile on signup. (Rate limits on login, signup and reset per IP and per email: done 2026-10-03.)

tasks.title: Admin usage page
tasks.description: Admin usage page: spend per user/guest/IP, top consumers; grant extra allowance, change plan, ban an account.

tasks.title: Account deletion + data export
tasks.description: Account settings: delete account (with its sessions) and export my data (GDPR, Québec Law 25).

tasks.title: Payments: checkout, portal, webhook
tasks.description: Payments: checkout + billing portal + webhook that only writes user.subscription. Paid = active/trialing, or past_due within grace.

tasks.title: Enforce session scoping
tasks.description: Enforce session scoping: model guard rejecting BrainstormSession queries without owner + test that guest B can't reach guest A's session.

tasks.title: Guest quotas need accounts
tasks.description: Plan limits: a guest resets every 3 h or on cookie clear, so quotas need accounts. Rate-limit guests by IP (esp. LLM calls).

tasks.title: Claim guest sessions at login
tasks.description: Auth: at login move guest sessions to the user + $unset expiresAt. Shared computer: claim silently, ask, or only since last logout?

tasks.title: Explain when cookies are blocked
tasks.description: Cookies blocked: New session shows "Session not found" and the list stays empty. Detect it and explain that cookies are needed.

tasks.title: Serve prod over HTTPS
tasks.description: Prod over plain HTTP (non-localhost): Secure guest cookie gets dropped, so the app breaks for everyone. Serve over HTTPS.

tasks.title: Guest expiry across tabs
tasks.description: Guest expiry in other tabs: a tab opened before the first session (made in another tab) has no timer, so it 404s instead of resetting.
